githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.7 Beta 11 brings Discord Markdown, live timestamps and custom emoji to profile bios, renders `:name:` emoji shortcodes, and redraws embeds at Discord's own sizes. It also shows when someone joined a server on their profile, keeps voice encryption working when someone leaves and rejoins a call, and removes the Show hidden channels option.

## Profiles

- Added Discord Markdown to bios in profile popovers, the member list and the DM sidebar: bold, italics, underline, strikethrough, spoilers, links, code, and custom and animated emoji.
- Added live timestamps to bios. They update as time passes and show the full date on hover, like timestamps in chat.
- Added the server join date to Member Since on server profiles. As in Discord, it sits beside the account creation date, and switches back to the account date alone if the member leaves or is removed.
- Changed people without an avatar to always show one of Discord's default avatars. While an avatar loads, a subtle circle shows instead of the first letter of their name.

## Messages

- Added `:name:` emoji shortcodes in messages and bios, including aliases such as `:+1:` and skin tones. A message made only of shortcodes shows them jumbo.
- Changed code to follow Discord's rules: mentions and custom emoji inside code stay as text, a code block can start mid-line, and a one-line block keeps its first word instead of treating it as a language.
- Changed links to display the way Discord shows them, for example `https://example.com` as `https://example.com/`.
- Fixed `snake_case` words and shortcodes like `:heart_eyes:` turning into italics.
- Fixed messages that mention one of your roles losing their highlight a moment after you sent them.
- Improved @ suggestions in large servers, which now keep members matched by nickname or display name alongside Discord's search results.

## Embeds

- Added Markdown and custom emoji to embed titles and field names, so bot messages such as level rewards show emoji images instead of raw codes.
- Changed embeds to use Discord's sizes and spacing for text, padding, icons and media. Field names now match their values in size, and embed text follows your message font size, as in Discord.

## Voice

- Fixed end-to-end encryption breaking when another participant left a voice call and rejoined while you stayed in it.
- Updated libdave, the library behind Discord's voice encryption, to 1.3.0.

## Fixes and polish

- Removed Show hidden channels. Discord now sends channels you can't view as nameless placeholders, so the option had nothing real left to show. Those channels stay out of the sidebar, as in Discord, and a channel that loses access while open shows Channel unavailable.
- Fixed thin dark lines appearing across tall images and long messages until you hovered them.
- Fixed typing and rendering slowing down on lines with a long run of unclosed backticks.

## Under the hood

- Replaced the offline preview mode with a local Discord simulator for development builds, so testing runs through SakuraCord's real Discord code. Release builds don't include it.
- Updated GRDB, swift-log and Sparkle.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.7-Beta-10...v0.1.7-Beta-11](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.7-Beta-10...v0.1.7-Beta-11)
discordAnnouncement:
**Rich profile bios, emoji shortcodes and Discord-sized embeds 🌙**

**Highlights**
- Profile bios now show Markdown, spoilers, code, custom emoji and live timestamps
- `:name:` shortcodes turn into emoji, with aliases, skin tones and jumbo emoji
- Embeds use Discord's own sizes and spacing, and their titles show Markdown and custom emoji
- Server profiles show when someone joined the server
- Voice encryption keeps working when someone leaves a call and rejoins
- Role mentions stay highlighted after you send them, and tall images no longer show dark lines
